caption: The drawing features a detailed graphite rendering of a tankard positioned at the center, shown in profile. The tankard is depicted with a large, curved handle on the left side, which loops downward and curls into a spiral shape at the base. The body of the tankard tapers slightly from a broader base to a narrower top, with two horizontal bands encircling the body, one near the top edge and one about a third of the way from the top. The drawing is set against a light beige background, with the central tankard drawing enclosed by a rectangle. Three smaller technical sketches are arranged around the central image: the upper left sketch shows a side section view of the handle with its dimensions, the upper right sketch provides a frontal view with measurements indicating the width at the top, bottom, and height, and the lower central sketch displays the tankard's circular base from above, also labeled with its diameter. A scale is drawn beneath the large rectangle, annotated with the word "SCALE" and marked as "2 in." The overall composition is monochromatic, using shades of gray and black.
title: Pewter Mug
